Kit summary

Demonic Triple SlashBasicExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2 · Lv.3
Deals 3 stages of 170% ATK [Bleed] DMG each to a single enemy.
Chaos Demon Spear Lv.1At the beginning of each wave, Mont Dan gains 15 layers of [Demon's Embrace] immediately. When [Demon's Embrace] is stacked to 20 layers, each time Mont Dan casts Demonic Triple Slash, additionally restores his HP by 400% of ATK. After casting Demonic Triple Slash, there is a 25% chance to pursue and attack the target once. Increases Mont Dan's DMG dealt to Boss to 300% of the original.
Chaos Demon Spear Lv.2When Mont Dan owns [Dark Blessing], he will gain a [Shield] by 20% of Max HP each time he pursues and attacks, lasting for 1 turn, up to 2 layers. Increases the HP Deduction effect caused by the 3rd stage of Demonic Triple Slash by 5% of the target's Max HP and increases its limit by 500% of Mont Dan's ATK. After Mont Dan casts Devil King's Descent, gains 1 layer of [Dark Blessing] and 5 layers of [Demon's Embrace] immediately, and pursues and attacks the enemy with the lowest HP twice. For every 1 ally with the [Bleed] tag deployed, increases Mont Dan's [Bleed] DMG dealt by 15%. When 5 allies with the [Bleed] tag are deployed, increases Mont Dan's [Bleed] DMG dealt to 200% of the original and increases all allies' [Bleed] DMG dealt by 30%. Each time Mont Dan casts Demonic Triple Slash, pursues and attacks, and casts skills, increases his Mastery and ATK by 5%, up to 300%.
Chaos Demon Spear Lv.3After each ally with the [HP Deduction] tag casts active skills, Mont Dan pursues and attacks the enemy with the lowest HP once. When 5 allies with the [HP Deduction] tag are deployed: 1. All DMG dealt by Demonic Triple Slash, Devil King's Impact, and Devil King's Descent ignores [DMG Immunity] and [Shield]. 2. When any turn starts, if 5 enemies' Tenacity and Mastery RES are higher than 150%, Mont Dan will cast Devil King's Descent once immediately. For every 1 ally with the [HP Deduction] tag deployed, increases Mont Dan's ATK by 50%.

When 5 allies with the [HP Deduction] tag are deployed: 1. All DMG dealt by Demonic Triple Slash, Devil King's Impact, and Devil King's Descent ignores [DMG Immunity] and [Shield]. 2. When any turn starts, if 5 enemies' Tenacity and Mastery RES are higher than 150%, Mont Dan will cast Devil King's Descent once immediately. For every 1 ally with the [HP Deduction] tag deployed, increases Mont Dan's ATK by 50%.
